I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the Marrow Agrisupply store is **Pine Crossing**.

She wrote it in #central-team herself on Jun 9. She said the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and the store wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template, but nobody has posted in the channel since to say it was fixed.

I only used #central-team, which Pree is a member of, and there were no finance figures involved.
